{{short description|Mathematical tool for calculating areas}}
In mathematics, the '''Burkill integral''' is an integral introduced by {{harvs|txt|last=Burkill|authorlink=John Charles Burkill|year1=1924a|year2=1924b}} for calculating areas. It is a special case of the [[Kolmogorov integral]].

*{{Citation | last1=Burkill | first1=J. C. | title=The expression of area as an integral | doi=10.1112/plms/s2-22.1.311  | year=1924b | journal= Proceedings of the London Mathematical Society | volume=22 | pages=311–336}}
